title: Apollo 11 timing: Trinity anniversary and Aquarius
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Apollo 11 timing: Trinity anniversary and Aquarius, about 1969 at The Moon, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Launched on July 16th, 1969, it coincided with the 24th anniversary of the Trinity atomic test, the dawn of the nuclear age.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points out that Apollo 11, the NASA mission that first landed people on the Moon, launched on July 16, 1969. According to Michels, that was exactly 24 years after Trinity, the first atomic bomb test, which he calls the dawn of the nuclear age. He sees the date as chosen on purpose, a hint that symbolic or ritual meaning shaped the space program.
